text:
Type: tall narrow pine chest of drawers
Use: storing clothes and small items; bedroom, hallway, small spaces
Style: Scandinavian, rustic, farmhouse
Materials: solid untreated knotty pine, round wooden knobs
Colors: pale natural pine, warm light honey knots
Shape: slender upright tower with five drawers, a shallow top drawer and four deeper ones, a single round knob on each, slightly overhanging top, straight square legs under a low apron, slim and light
Feel: natural, warm, simple, casual
Goes with: white walls, linen and wool textiles, black or green accents; Scandinavian, rustic or farmhouse bedrooms

product.name: TARVA
product.description: Of course your home should be a safe place for the entire family. Thats why a safety fitting is included so that you can attach the chest of drawers to the wall.
